title: Inline photo notes and the rich markdown editor

completion_criteria.text: The four rich-editor audits (prototype editor, app capture/storage, package landscape, single-TextField substrate limits) are complete, cited, and committed under docs/specs/research/
The editor substrate architecture is decided and recorded as a decision record with its rejected alternatives and pre-mortem
A detailed spec covering BOTH the rich markdown editor AND OQ-6 exists, orders the editor strictly before OQ-6, and resolves every unreachable value at spec time
The existing P0-P5 inline-photo ladder has been re-read against the no-wrap-in-EditableText limit and either amended or explicitly re-affirmed
The spec is implemented via mitosis, every MSP leaving note capture working on its own merge commit
No schema migration was required, or one shipped as its own MSP with a successful-upgrade test and a rollback proven on a copy of a real journal

spine.active_goal: Ship a rich markdown note editor built on markdown source of truth, then OQ-6's inline anchored photos on top of it — one controller seam, editor strictly first, no schema migration at any point.
spine.next_step: WRITE THE SPEC, fully, as the fresh session's first act: ONE detailed spec covering the rich markdown editor AND OQ-6, editor strictly first, decomposed into mitosis-ready MSPs. Read first, do NOT re-derive: docs/specs/research/2026-08-02-editor-*.md (four audits), .claude/ledger/decisions/2026-08-02-markdown-source-of-truth-editor.md, and docs/specs/2026-08-02-inline-photo-notes.md (1228 lines, NEVER critic-hardened, re-read it against the no-wrap-in-EditableText limit).
open_risks: TEXT CANNOT WRAP AROUND AN INLINE OBJECT IN AN EditableText — flutter#82595, open since 2021. OQ-6's float+wrap can ONLY live in the read view (NoteBody, a Text) and arrange mode, never the editor. The P0-P5 ladder MUST be re-read against this.
The 1228-line spec at 5ba0624 was NEVER hardened by the critic — the workflow died mid-flight. Treat every citation in it as unverified. This spec family has cited WRONG line numbers FIVE times.
The markdown-source-of-truth decision is Status: PROPOSED. The user has not ratified it. Confirm before building on it.

TWO OPEN SCOPE CALLS are the user's: pay the computeLineMetrics overlay cost for quote bars or cut them; same for tappable to-do checkboxes, which need a hit-tested overlay (TapGestureRecognizer in buildTextSpan throws on iOS, flutter#187598, repro'd on 3.44.1).

NO DATABASE MIGRATION, EVER. schemaVersion is 1 and onUpgrade unconditionally throws (app_database.dart:17, :25-32), pinned by app_database_test.dart:27-31 and :98-127. A wrong first migration makes every existing journal unopenable.
Baseline is 944 passed / 0 failed / analyze clean on main. MEASURE it on your own branch, never inherit — it has gone stale three times.

Predicted first failure: type-to-transform x undo/redo x IME composing. Gate every programmatic mutation on composing.isCollapsed; flutter#130881 shows the built-in undo stack already desyncs from IME with no custom code.
The prototype DESTROYS photos on re-edit (n.photos = undefined). Name it an explicit non-goal so no one ports the bug.
gh pr create and gh pr merge are BOTH denied globally. PRs go through the pr-create tool; every merge is human. CI IS NOT EVIDENCE — no GitHub check runs a Dart test here.
out_of_scope: OQ-3 (entry-card Edit/Delete placement) — deliberately set aside by the user; still the last open criterion of the separate prototype-design-alignment thread.
Nested lists and indent, links, and custom undo/redo beyond Flutter's built-in UndoHistory — none exist in the prototype to reference.
Any editor package: super_editor, flutter_quill, appflowy_editor, re_editor and flutter_markdown are all rejected on named constraints.
Any database migration or schema change.
Editable text that wraps around an inline object — structurally impossible in Flutter; write mode stays plain.
Arbitrary pixel positioning of photos. The anchor is a position in the text, never an (x, y).
